units.source_text: 夕阳西沉，暮色苍茫，四周景物清幽。

en.t: The setting sun sank in the west, dusk spread vast and dim, and the scenery all around was quiet and secluded.

units.source_text: 源氏从三公主处辞出，立刻前往访问明石夫人。

en.t: After taking his leave from the Third Princess, Genji immediately went to visit Lady Akashi.

units.source_text: 长久不光临，突然来访，明石夫人吃了一惊，然而接待时态度十分大方。

en.t: Because he had not called for so long, his sudden visit startled Lady Akashi, yet she received him with great composure.

units.source_text: 源氏甚喜，觉得此人毕竟胜人一筹。

en.t: Genji was very pleased and felt that she was, after all, superior to others.

units.source_text: 然而回想紫夫人，又觉得另有一功，特富风趣。

en.t: Yet when he thought back on Lady Murasaki, he felt that she had another kind of excellence, especially rich in grace and charm.

units.source_text: 两相比较一会，紫夫人的面影浮现眼前，悲伤恋慕之情越发增添了。

en.t: After comparing the two for a while, Lady Murasaki's image rose before his eyes, and his sorrow and longing grew still deeper.

units.source_text: 他很痛苦，自念有何办法可得安慰呢。

en.t: He was in great pain and wondered to himself what means there might be to gain comfort.

units.source_text: 但既到了这里，且和明石夫人闲谈往事。

en.t: But since he had come here, he talked idly with Lady Akashi about things of the past.

units.source_text: 他说：“专心钟爱一人，实乃一大恶事。

en.t: He said, "To set one's whole heart on loving a single person is truly a great wrong.

units.source_text: 我从小就注意及此，故时时刻刻留意，务使在任何方面对此世间无所执著。

en.t: I have been mindful of this since childhood, and so I have always taken care not to be attached to this world in any respect.

units.source_text: 当大势变迁、我身颠沛流离之时，东思西想，但觉生趣全无，不如自己抛舍了这条性命，或者逃入深山穷谷，亦不觉有何障碍。

en.t: When the times changed and I was cast into wandering hardship, I thought in every direction and felt life held no pleasure at all; to throw away my life myself, or to flee into deep mountains and remote valleys, seemed no obstacle to me.

units.source_text: 岂知终于不能出家，以致到了晚年、大限将近之时，犹为种种琐屑之事所羁绊，因循苟安，迁延至今。

en.t: Yet who would have known that in the end I could not take vows, so that even now, in old age with my appointed end drawing near, I am still bound by all sorts of trifling matters, drifting along in compromise and delay until this day.

units.source_text: 意志如此薄弱，思之实甚痛心！”

en.t: That my will is so weak truly pains me when I think of it!"

units.source_text: 此言并不专指某事而诉说悲情，但明石夫人察知他的心事，觉得此亦理之当然，对他十分同情，便答道：“即使是别人看来毫不足惜的人，本人心中自然也有种种牵累。

en.t: These words did not point to any one matter as he poured out his sadness, but Lady Akashi perceived what was in his heart, felt that it was only natural, sympathized deeply with him, and answered, "Even someone who seems scarcely worth regretting in the eyes of others naturally has many ties within their own heart.

units.source_text: 何况尊贵之人，岂能安心舍离人世？

en.t: How much less could a person of noble rank peacefully abandon and leave the world?

units.source_text: 草草出家，反被世人讥为轻率，请勿急切从事为要。

en.t: If you take vows hastily, people will instead criticize you as rash, so it is important that you not act in haste.

units.source_text: 慎重考虑，看来似是迟钝，但一经出家，道心坚固，决不退转，此理当蒙明察。

en.t: Careful consideration may appear slow, but once one has taken vows, one's resolve for the Way will be firm and will never turn back; I trust you understand this principle clearly.

units.source_text: 试看昔人事例：有的为了身受刺激，有的为了事与愿违，便萌厌世之念，因而遁入空门。

en.t: Look at examples from people of old: some, after suffering a shock, and others, after matters went against their wishes, formed a distaste for the world and entered the Buddhist gate.

units.source_text: 但这终非妥善之事。

en.t: But in the end, that is not a proper course.

units.source_text: 君既发心出家，目下尚须暂缓，且待皇子长大成人，确保储君之位，然后可以安心修道。

en.t: Since you have resolved to take vows, you should still wait for the time being, and only after the prince has grown to adulthood and his position as heir is secure can you practice the Way with peace of mind.

units.source_text: 那时我辈也都欢喜赞善了。”

en.t: At that time, all of us too will gladly praise and approve it."

units.source_text: 她这番话说得头头是道，颇为恰当。

en.t: Her words were thoroughly reasonable and quite appropriate.

units.source_text: 但源氏答道：“如此深思远虑，恐怕反不如轻率者好呢。”

en.t: But Genji replied, "Such deep thought and long planning may perhaps be worse than rashness."

units.source_text: 便向她叙述过去种种可悲之事，其中有云：“昔年藤壶母后逝世的春天，我看见了樱花的颜色，便想起‘山樱若是多情种……’之诗。

en.t: Then he told her of many sad things from the past, among them saying, "In the spring when Empress Mother Fujitsubo died, I saw the color of the cherry blossoms and remembered the poem, 'If the mountain cherry had a feeling heart...'

units.source_text: 这是因为她那举世赞颂的优美姿色，是我从小见惯的，所以她逝世之时，我比别人更为悲伤。

en.t: This was because I had been used since childhood to seeing her beautiful appearance, praised by all the world, and so when she died I grieved more than others.

units.source_text: 可知悲伤之情，并非由于自身对死者有特殊关系而来。

en.t: From this one can see that the feeling of grief does not arise only because one has a special relationship with the dead.

units.source_text: 如今那个长年相伴之人，忽然先我而死，使我悲伤不已，哀思难忘。

en.t: Now the one who had been my companion for so many years has suddenly died before me, leaving me endlessly sorrowful and unable to forget my grief.

units.source_text: 并非仅为夫妇死别而悲伤，又因此人从小由我抚育成长，朝夕与共，到了垂老之年，忽然舍我而去，使我悼惜死者，痛念自身，实在悲伤不堪。

en.t: It is not merely the sorrow of husband and wife parted by death; because this person was raised by me from childhood, shared mornings and evenings with me, and then, when I had reached old age, suddenly abandoned me and went away, I mourn the dead, grieve over myself, and truly find the sadness unbearable.

units.source_text: 凡人深于情感，饶有才能，富于风趣，种种方面使人念念不忘者，死后受人哀悼甚深。”

en.t: Anyone who is deep in feeling, richly talented, full of charm, and unforgettable in many ways is deeply mourned by people after death."

units.source_text: 如此纵谈往事今情，直至夜深。

en.t: In this way they spoke freely of past events and present feelings until deep into the night.

units.source_text: 今夜似应在此泊宿了，然而终于起身告辞。

en.t: It seemed that he ought to spend the night there, yet in the end he rose and took his leave.

units.source_text: 明石夫人心中定感不快。

en.t: Lady Akashi must surely have felt displeased in her heart.

units.source_text: 源氏自己也觉得奇怪。

en.t: Genji himself also found it strange.
